title: Jegog: Gamelan of the Love God

drums.description: Experimental percussion track, A dry, wooden rimshot or stick-click pattern repeats every four beats, A low-frequency, resonant kick drum hits on the first beat of every measure, A metallic, high-pitched shaker or tambourine-like jingle occurs on the fourth beat, The tempo is 100 BPM in 4/4 time, The recording features a close-mic proximity with minimal room reverb and a high degree of transient clarity Publish

bass.description: Industrial techno with heavy distortion and mechanical textures, A distorted kick drum plays a steady four-on-the-floor pattern with a long, saturated decay, A high-pitched, resonant synth pulse repeats on every sixteenth note, processed with a rhythmic gate and bitcrushing, A metallic, percussive sequence with heavy reverb provides a syncopated counter-rhythm, The track features a constant low-frequency drone with a slow filter sweep, 135 BPM, Key of D minor, 4/4 time signature, High-frequency white noise bursts occur every four bars, The mix is heavily compressed with a prominent sidechain pumping effect triggered by the kick drum Publish
